sourceTitle: 亚马逊公布企业岗位调整，将减少层级与增加责任归属列为方向
originalTitle: Staying nimble and continuing to strengthen our organizations
author: Beth Galetti, Senior Vice President of People Experience, Technology at Amazon

blocks.text: The message below was shared with Amazon employees earlier today.
blocks.zh: 以下信息今天早些时候与亚马逊员工分享.
blocks.en: The message below was shared with Amazon employees earlier today.

blocks.text: I want to let you know that we're making organizational changes across Amazon that will impact some of our teammates. There will be communications from leaders to those teams and individuals today, but we also wanted to share the broader context about what’s happening and why.
blocks.zh: 我想告诉你 我们正在亚马逊各地进行组织变革 这会影响我们的一些队友今天,领导人将向这些小组和个人发函,但我们也想分享更多关于事情发生及原因的背景。
blocks.en: I want to let you know that we're making organizational changes across Amazon that will impact some of our teammates. There will be communications from leaders to those teams and individuals today, but we also wanted to share the broader context about what’s happening and why.

blocks.text: Last year, Andy posted a note about strengthening our culture and teams – explaining how we want to operate like the world’s largest startup, the importance of having the right structure to drive that level of speed and ownership, and the need to be set up to invent, collaborate, be connected, and deliver the absolute best for customers. Many of you have put significant effort into that work of strengthening your organizations by reducing layers, increasing ownership, and helping reduce bureaucracy. We're already seeing the results, with teams moving faster and many Amazonians feeling more ownership, and the S-team and I appreciate all the work you've done. The reductions we’re sharing today are a continuation of this work to get even stronger by further reducing bureaucracy, removing layers, and shifting resources to ensure we’re investing in our biggest bets and what matters most to our customers’ current and future needs.
blocks.zh: 去年,我们...Andy张贴了一篇关于加强我们的文化和团队的说明,必须有适当的结构来推动这种速度和主人翁精神,和必须建立 发明,协作,连接,并且为客户提供绝对最好的。你们中许多人为通过缩小层次加强你们组织的工作作出了重大努力,增加所有权,并且帮助减少官僚主义。我们已经看到结果了许多亚马逊人觉得拥有更多的所有权,和S队,我很感激你所做的一切工作。我们今天分享的削减是这项工作的继续,通过进一步减少官僚主义而变得更加强大,删除层,并转移资源,以确保我们投资最大的赌注,以及对于我们的客户当前和未来的需求最为重要的东西。
blocks.en: Last year, Andy posted a note about strengthening our culture and teams – explaining how we want to operate like the world’s largest startup, the importance of having the right structure to drive that level of speed and ownership, and the need to be set up to invent, collaborate, be connected, and deliver the absolute best for customers. Many of you have put significant effort into that work of strengthening your organizations by reducing layers, increasing ownership, and helping reduce bureaucracy. We're already seeing the results, with teams moving faster and many Amazonians feeling more ownership, and the S-team and I appreciate all the work you've done. The reductions we’re sharing today are a continuation of this work to get even stronger by further reducing bureaucracy, removing layers, and shifting resources to ensure we’re investing in our biggest bets and what matters most to our customers’ current and future needs.

blocks.text: While this will include reducing in some areas and hiring in others, it will mean an overall reduction in our corporate workforce of approximately 14,000 roles. We’re working hard to support everyone whose role is impacted, including offering most employees 90 days to look for a new role internally (the timing will vary some based on local laws), and our recruiting teams will prioritize internal candidates to help as many people as possible find new roles within Amazon. For our teammates who are unable to find a new role at Amazon or who choose not to look for one, we’ll offer them transition support including severance pay, outplacement services, health insurance benefits, and more.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们会在部分领域缩减岗位，同时在其他领域招聘，但总体上，公司职能岗位将减少约 14,000 个。我们正在努力支持每一位岗位受到影响的员工，包括给予大多数员工 90 天时间寻找内部新岗位（具体时长会因当地法律而有所不同）；招聘团队也会优先考虑内部候选人，帮助尽可能多的员工在亚马逊找到新岗位。对于未能在亚马逊找到新岗位，或选择不再寻找内部岗位的同事，我们将提供过渡支持，包括遣散费、再就业安置服务、健康保险福利等。
blocks.en: While this will include reducing in some areas and hiring in others, it will mean an overall reduction in our corporate workforce of approximately 14,000 roles. We’re working hard to support everyone whose role is impacted, including offering most employees 90 days to look for a new role internally (the timing will vary some based on local laws), and our recruiting teams will prioritize internal candidates to help as many people as possible find new roles within Amazon. For our teammates who are unable to find a new role at Amazon or who choose not to look for one, we’ll offer them transition support including severance pay, outplacement services, health insurance benefits, and more.

blocks.text: Looking ahead to 2026, as Andy talked about earlier this year, we expect to continue hiring in key strategic areas while also finding additional places we can remove layers, increase ownership, and realize efficiency gains.
blocks.zh: 展望2026年正如安迪今年早些时候说的,我们期待在关键战略领域继续雇用人员,同时找到更多我们可以清除层层的地方,增加所有权,并实现增效。
blocks.en: Looking ahead to 2026, as Andy talked about earlier this year, we expect to continue hiring in key strategic areas while also finding additional places we can remove layers, increase ownership, and realize efficiency gains.

blocks.text: Some may ask why we’re reducing roles when the company is performing well. Across our businesses, we're delivering great customer experiences every day, innovating at a rapid rate, and producing strong business results. What we need to remember is that the world is changing quickly. This generation of AI is the most transformative technology we’ve seen since the Internet, and it's enabling companies to innovate much faster than ever before (in existing market segments and altogether new ones). We’re convinced that we need to be organized more leanly, with fewer layers and more ownership, to move as quickly as possible for our customers and business.
blocks.zh: 有人可能会问,当公司表现良好时,我们为什么要减少角色?在我们的生意中我们每天都有很好的顾客体验以迅猛的速度创新,并产生强大的商业成果。我们需要记住的是,世界正在迅速变化。这一代的AI是我们自互联网以来所见到的最具变革性的技术,这让公司能够比以往更快地创新(在现有的市场和全新的市场部门)。我们深信我们需要更精细地组织起来,更少的层次和更多的所有权,为了我们的顾客和企业 尽快行动起来
blocks.en: Some may ask why we’re reducing roles when the company is performing well. Across our businesses, we're delivering great customer experiences every day, innovating at a rapid rate, and producing strong business results. What we need to remember is that the world is changing quickly. This generation of AI is the most transformative technology we’ve seen since the Internet, and it's enabling companies to innovate much faster than ever before (in existing market segments and altogether new ones). We’re convinced that we need to be organized more leanly, with fewer layers and more ownership, to move as quickly as possible for our customers and business.

blocks.text: I don’t know of any other company with the breadth of Amazon, the number of exciting bold bets we’re making, and all the ways we can make customers lives better and easier around the world. I’m inspired by what I see across the company every day, and the S-team and I appreciate all that you do.
blocks.zh: 我不知道还有哪个公司 与亚马逊的宽度,我们的大胆赌注,以及我们能让世界各地的顾客生活更好、更轻松的各种方法。我每天在公司看到的东西启发着我,和S -team,我很感激你所做的一切。
blocks.en: I don’t know of any other company with the breadth of Amazon, the number of exciting bold bets we’re making, and all the ways we can make customers lives better and easier around the world. I’m inspired by what I see across the company every day, and the S-team and I appreciate all that you do.
